info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Expiration Inquiry API enables users to check the expiration status of their hotel loyalty points. This feature is essential for customers seeking to maximize their rewards by understanding when their points will expire. Typically used by frequent travelers and loyalty program members, this API provides information on point validity, helping users make informed decisions about redeeming their rewards. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance user engagement and improve loyalty program effectiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about points that have expired. It is useful for understanding what points are no longer valid and managing customer loyalty effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body specifies the parameters required to expire points. The data should adhere to the defined schema to ensure proper processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved expiration details for points.
